event.description: Share both head-local attention output maps across depth blocks
event.proposal: family: attention organization; current retained incumbent is 2781 parameters at 100.0000%, a +1.00 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family most recent accepted result: attempt-0066, sharing head 0's 7x7 attention output map across the two blocks at 2781 parameters and 100.00%; same-family most recent failed result: attempt-0057, block-diagonal Q projections at 2688 parameters and 0.01%; prior attempts in this family: 13. Hypothesis: because one cross-depth head-local output tie is fully qualified, share the complementary head 1 output map across both blocks while preserving both causal attention applications, all Q/KV projections, and the two distinct head-local maps as a pair. This removes the second 49-parameter map for a target of 2732. It is more informative than the nearest untested cross-layer Q or KV tie because it completes the already accepted output-map interpolation and isolates whether both heads can use depth-shared output coordinates before constraining attention-score formation. Keep d14/h2/L2 MQA, ff23 with one within-block tied hidden unit shared across blocks, rank8 positions, two final group scales, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy at least 99% and strictly fewer parameters than the incumbent.
